# pvecli snapshot

Snapshots across many guests: add, list, prune.

| Command | What it does |
|:--|:--|
| [`add`](add.md) | Take the same snapshot on every selected guest, before a risky change. |
| [`list`](list.md) | Snapshots of many guests, with their age (every guest when no filter). |
| [`prune`](prune.md) | Delete old snapshots. Shows what would go, deletes only once confirmed. |
